channel.title: Crypto Asia news
channel.description: Short crypto news briefs with links to the original publishers.

item.title: Sky's TVL drops 15% weekly as USDS supply shrinks
item.description: Total value locked in the Sky protocol fell 15% over the past week, while USDS circulating supply declined to $5.59 billion. Sky.money currently lists a 3.80% savings rate set by governance. (Source: The Defiant)

item.title: Ripple CEO Says XRP Remains Company's Core Focus
item.description: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse reaffirmed XRP as the company's north star, tying RLUSD expansion and business integration to more liquidity and utility for the token. His strategy aims at more payments and institutional activity across the XRP ecosystem. (Source: Bitcoin.com News)

item.title: EU Creates Crypto Task Force to Stop Russian Sanctions Evasion
item.description: The European Union is setting up a dedicated crypto task force within a new sanctions office to coordinate national authorities. It aims to stop evasion of sanctions using digital assets, including networks such as A7 that offered a digital ruble stablecoin. (Source: Bitcoin.com News)

item.title: Bitcoin Trails Restaurant Chain Stocks Over Six Months
item.description: Bitcoin's price has declined over the past six months, lagging several restaurant chain stocks, though it still outperformed Nvidia's shares. (Source: BeInCrypto)

item.title: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law with 10% Gains and 15% DeFi Levies
item.description: Greece's parliament has approved a tax framework setting a 10% rate on crypto capital gains and 15% on income from staking, lending and DeFi. It marks the country's first comprehensive treatment of digital asset taxation. (Source: Bitcoin.com News)

item.title: Aave Labs Buys Avon Team to Build Fixed-Rate Lending
item.description: Aave Labs has acquired the Avon team, which brings its lending protocols and onchain order book. No first market or launch date has been announced yet. (Source: The Defiant)

item.title: US Treasury Severs Crypto Exchange MEXC From American Financial System
item.description: FinCEN has ordered U.S. institutions to stop all transfers to and from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance linked to Iran, North Korea and Russia. The action is part of Operation Economic Outcast. (Source: Decrypt)

item.title: US Imposes Sanctions on 45 More Prince Group-Linked Targets
item.description: The US Treasury's OFAC has sanctioned additional offshore companies and associates it says helped Prince Group executives conceal assets and evade earlier sanctions. The action targets an alleged crypto scam network. (Source: Decrypt)

item.title: Thai regulator files criminal complaint against Bitget operator
item.description: Thailand's SEC has lodged a criminal complaint against BG Limited, the operator of Bitget, over alleged unlicensed trading in Thailand from 2022 to 2025. The move comes ahead of a planned December 5 access block. (Source: Bitcoin Magazine)

item.title: Gnosis Pay says hackers accessed some customer data
item.description: Crypto card provider Gnosis Pay said attackers got into customer information on a legacy system behind its branded cards. Funds were not affected, and its enterprise card platform was not touched. (Source: Decrypt)

item.title: Binance severs ties with SignalPlus after fake Teams invite hack
item.description: Binance cut off trading platform SignalPlus following a breach that began with a fraudulent Microsoft Teams invitation. SignalPlus later reported losses below $82,000 and said reimbursement is underway, while Deribit also disabled connected keys. (Source: CryptoSlate)

item.title: Strive posts $509M Q3 profit on bitcoin gains
item.description: Strive reported a profitable third quarter driven by bitcoin gains, with its bitcoin holdings reaching 43,124 BTC. Its shares continued to decline over the period. (Source: The Block)

item.title: US Retirement Rule Allowing Crypto in 401(k)s Nears Completion
item.description: A final rule permitting crypto in 401(k) retirement plans is under White House review, and the timing for savers to access it is in focus. Details on when this could happen are not provided here. (Source: BeInCrypto)

item.title: Optimism proposal would reduce Security Council authority over standalone chains
item.description: A proposed policy would let qualifying transfers move forward without another governance vote, changing how users depend on parties for network upgrades. The change concerns the Optimism ecosystem's governance. (Source: CryptoSlate)

item.title: Bitrue Rebrands Around Bitrue AI, Moving Beyond Its XRP Focus
item.description: Crypto exchange Bitrue announced a brand shift placing Bitrue AI at the center of its identity. The company is moving from being known mainly for XRP trading toward an AI-focused crypto platform. (Source: BeInCrypto)

item.title: Ripple-backed XRP treasury firm Evernorth shares fall sharply after listing
item.description: Evernorth, backed by Ripple, has dropped nearly 47% since its October Nasdaq listing. A new filing shows 73.7 million shares that holders could resell, raising concerns about possible selling pressure. (Source: BeInCrypto)

item.title: Eric Trump-Linked American Bitcoin Reports $126M Profit, Shares Fall
item.description: American Bitcoin Corp., a bitcoin miner co-founded by Eric Trump, posted about $126 million in third-quarter net income after prior losses. The Nasdaq-listed firm holds 8,427 BTC, though its mining costs rose and its shares dropped. (Source: Bitcoin.com News)

item.title: Amundi launches tokenized equity index fund on Ethereum
item.description: Europe's largest asset manager, Amundi, has tokenized an equity index fund on Ethereum. The new share class gives blockchain-based exposure to an index covering 600 companies across European markets. (Source: Cointelegraph)

item.title: Hong Kong to require crypto providers to track customer trades
item.description: Covered crypto providers will have to collect transaction information starting in 2027, ahead of the tax department beginning international information exchanges under CARF in 2028. (Source: CryptoSlate)

item.title: Trump Media shifts $342M in bitcoin to Crypto.com
item.description: Blockchain data tracked by Arkham shows a wallet linked to Trump Media sent a large bitcoin transfer to Crypto.com. The amount is reported as $342 million. (Source: CoinDesk)

item.title: Nearly $1B in Crypto Liquidations as Bitcoin Rises 4.6%
item.description: Crypto liquidations totaled $974.80 million over 24 hours as prices climbed, with most losses hitting traders betting on declines, per Coinglass. Bitcoin rose 4.64% to $80,480. (Source: BeInCrypto)

item.title: Crypto Groups Challenge Illinois' 0.2% Crypto Tax in Court
item.description: Crypto industry groups are seeking to have Illinois' 0.2% levy struck down. The tax would be based on asset value rather than gains, and covered brokers would have to collect it from customers. (Source: The Defiant)

item.title: Coinbase Opens Deribit Derivatives to US Prime Institutional Clients
item.description: Institutional clients in the US can now reach global derivatives through Coinbase Financial Markets. The excerpt notes that shared liquidity does not mean a single margin pool. (Source: The Defiant)

item.title: Bitcoin climbs back above $80,000 as oil falls sharply
item.description: Bitcoin has regained the $80,000 level while US oil prices dropped about 12% following a Democratic win in Congress. The report also notes factors that could reverse both moves. (Source: BeInCrypto)

item.title: Zcash grants committee scraps plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC
item.description: The Zcash grants committee has withdrawn its proposal to send 98,000 ZEC toward future mining rewards after community pushback. Competing proposals remain on the table, one to end its funding and another to keep the existing grants system. (Source: CoinDesk)

item.title: ZachXBT names French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa in $133M crypto theft
item.description: On-chain investigator ZachXBT has identified Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as the alleged victim of a theft he estimates at over $133 million. The bank had not issued a public statement when the report was written. (Source: BeInCrypto)

item.title: Bitcoin rebounds from seven-week low as Democrats sweep Congress
item.description: Bitcoin dipped to a seven-week low of $75,618 as crypto long liquidations approached $300 million over 24 hours. The article links the price move to the Democratic sweep of Congress. (Source: Cointelegraph)

item.title: 1inch lawyer expects US agencies to shape crypto rules amid midterms
item.description: A 1inch lawyer says US regulatory agencies are likely to drive crypto policy regardless of how the midterm elections turn out. The excerpt gives no further detail. (Source: Cointelegraph)

item.title: Experts Say Payments Could Give Crypto Super Apps Daily Use
item.description: At TOKEN2049 Singapore, panelists from firms including MetaMask, Trezor and WalletConnect discussed whether payments could make crypto an everyday financial service. The debate centred on everyday use rather than trading. (Source: BeInCrypto)

item.title: Moscow Exchange Sets Dec. 1 Start for Crypto Trading
item.description: Russia's Moscow Exchange has announced it will begin cryptocurrency trading on December 1, offering bitcoin, ether and USDT. The exchange described it as the country's first organized digital currency market. (Source: Bitcoin.com News)

item.title: RUNE gains 15% as THORChain resumes most swaps after pause
item.description: THORChain has restored trading on Bitcoin, Ethereum and several other networks after a refund bug halted activity. Three chains remain paused. (Source: Cointelegraph)

item.title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallet Activity Slows Again in October
item.description: Long-dormant bitcoin wallets moved about 2,159 BTC last month, a second straight monthly decline. Wallets from 2013 accounted for much of the activity, while addresses from the earliest years were largely absent. (Source: Bitcoin.com News)

item.title: Traders Worry About Democratic Midterm Sweep Ahead of Election Day
item.description: Crypto traders are reportedly concerned that Democrats could win a midterm sweep, with Ohio's outcome seen as significant. The excerpt also points to a Bitcoin price level being watched during the anxiety. (Source: BeInCrypto)

item.title: Tether CEO Says Bitcoin Holdings Exceed Publicly Reported Amounts
item.description: Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino disclosed a bitcoin treasury larger than what the stablecoin issuer's financial statements previously showed. He made the remarks at a Swiss crypto conference. (Source: Bitcoin.com News)

item.title: Hong Kong bank pilot enables round-the-clock settlement for tokenized fund deals
item.description: A pilot in Hong Kong lets participating institutions settle tokenized deposit transactions in central bank money outside conventional hours. The service is aimed at supporting treasury and fund activity. (Source: CryptoSlate)

item.title: Quickex Rolls Out Private Swap to Limit Visible Wallet Links
item.description: Quickex, a crypto swap service active since 2018, has launched Private Swap, which aims to reduce the public on-chain connection between sending and receiving wallets. The feature uses the same basic conversion steps as a standard Quickex swap. (Source: Bitcoin.com News)

item.title: Bitcoin holds near $76K lows as US midterms loom
item.description: Bitcoin posted modest gains at the open of Wall Street trading on Tuesday while markets looked ahead to the US midterm elections for direction. (Source: Cointelegraph)

item.title: US regulator clears perpetual futures on single stocks for first time
item.description: The CFTC has allowed American exchanges to list perpetual futures contracts linked to individual stocks. The move marks the first time such products have been approved in the US. (Source: The Block)

item.title: Dollar stablecoin use stays high after capital controls lift, research finds
item.description: New research suggests that dollar stablecoin usage did not detectably reverse after capital controls were removed. The monetary-policy implications of this pattern remain unresolved. (Source: CryptoSlate)

item.title: BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF records its largest outflow since June
item.description: BlackRock's IBIT Bitcoin fund lost $405.3 million on Monday. US spot Bitcoin ETFs opened November with close to $399 million in net outflows overall. (Source: Cointelegraph)
